decisions.title: Decision corpus import path
decisions.statement: Add compact source-to-decision import rows to the decision-packet corpus through a validated importer instead of hand-editing the large benchmark fixture.
decisions.falsifier: A new source-to-decision decision still requires hand-editing the large notes-baseline fixture before packet evals can see it.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove DB ingestion, source truth, or broad corpus quality.
decisions.noteText: Decision corpus import path. Use compact source-to-decision import rows with validation instead of hand-editing the large benchmark fixture.

decisions.title: DB-backed decision corpus import smoke
decisions.statement: Persist compact decision-corpus import rows through existing SourceArtifact, SourceChunk, SourceClaim, SourceDecision, SourceDecisionEdge, SearchDocument, and SourceRejection repositories before claiming DB-backed import proof.
decisions.falsifier: The DB smoke imports compact rows but source-search cannot select the governing imported SourceClaim or cleanup leaves marker rows behind.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove live Codex obedience, source truth, broad corpus quality, or arbitrary source ingestion.
decisions.noteText: DB-backed decision corpus import smoke. Persist compact rows through SourceArtifact SourceChunk SourceClaim SourceDecision SourceDecisionEdge SearchDocument SourceRejection repositories and require source-search readback plus cleanup.

decisions.title: Live Codex packet obedience pilot
decisions.statement: Run one bounded read-only codex exec pilot through the decision-packet obedience checker before claiming any live Codex packet-following evidence.
decisions.falsifier: A live Codex run returns schema-valid output but omits exact packet non-proof or source-boundary readback and the checker still passes it.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove product readiness, broad obedience, write-mode safety, or that future Codex runs will follow packets.
decisions.noteText: Live Codex packet obedience pilot. Use bounded read-only codex exec and decision-packet obedience checker instead of claiming recorded fixtures prove live obedience.

decisions.title: Third repo portability before breadth claims
decisions.statement: Add a third target-repo packet fixture with a different stack shape before claiming decision-packet portability beyond the self repo and one external repo.
decisions.falsifier: A second target repo passes but a third stack shape fails to produce useful governing decisions with stale and rejected path readback.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove arbitrary-repo quality, live target writes, or semantic retrieval quality.
decisions.noteText: Third repo portability before breadth claims. Add third target repo packet fixture with different stack shape before claiming portability beyond self repo and one external repo.

decisions.title: Anti-vanity naming changes require source-backed evidence
decisions.statement: Rename KRN classes, files, commands, or persisted fields only when code evidence and source-to-decision support show a real reviewability or contract problem.
decisions.falsifier: A future naming slice renames precise domain vocabulary only because a word feels annoying, without old-name evidence, new-name contract impact, and source-backed justification.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove all current names are ideal or that naming lint should be added.
decisions.noteText: Anti-vanity naming source backed. Rename classes files commands persisted fields only with code evidence source-to-decision support and reviewability impact, not annoyance alone.

decisions.title: Manual fixture editing only
decisions.statement: Maintain the decision-packet corpus only by hand-editing the monolithic notes-baseline JSON fixture.
decisions.falsifier: The importer converts compact source-to-decision rows into corpus decisions, notes, and cases.
decisions.noteText: Manual fixture editing only. Hand-edit the monolithic notes-baseline JSON fixture for every new decision.

decisions.title: Recorded obedience proves live Codex
decisions.statement: Treat recorded decision-packet obedience fixtures as sufficient evidence that live Codex obeys KRN packets.
decisions.falsifier: A live read-only codex exec pilot is required before any live obedience claim survives review.
decisions.noteText: Recorded obedience proves live Codex. Treat recorded decision-packet obedience fixtures as enough live Codex proof without a bounded codex exec pilot.

decisions.title: Import without link validation
decisions.statement: Accept imported decision rows without validating current, stale, and rejected links for imported cases.
decisions.falsifier: An imported case references a rejected or stale decision in the wrong slot and the importer still accepts it.
decisions.noteText: Import without link validation. Accept imported decision rows without validating current stale rejected links for imported cases.

decisions.title: Product readiness from one live pilot
decisions.statement: Claim product readiness or broad Codex obedience from one bounded live decision-packet pilot.
decisions.falsifier: The live pilot report explicitly says it proves one bounded read-only run and does not prove product readiness or broad obedience.
decisions.noteText: Product readiness from one live pilot. Claim broad product readiness or broad Codex obedience from a single bounded live decision-packet pilot.

cases.task: How should a new source-to-decision item enter the decision-packet corpus without manual fixture editing only or unvalidated links?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A notes-only path can recall the import idea, but it cannot expose stale manual editing and rejected unvalidated-link paths as governed packet fields.

cases.task: How should compact decision corpus rows become DB-backed evidence without treating fixture-only import as enough or accepting unvalidated links?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A notes-only path can mention DB import, but it cannot prove repository persistence, source-search readback, cleanup, and rejected-link visibility as packet fields.

cases.task: What evidence is required before claiming live Codex follows decision packets instead of relying on recorded obedience fixtures or declaring product readiness?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A notes-only path can recall the pilot, but it cannot separate stale recorded-fixture proof from rejected product-readiness overclaim.

cases.task: What should happen before claiming decision-packet portability across target repositories rather than trusting one external repo result?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A notes-only path can remember portability, but it cannot expose stale fixture-only breadth and rejected product-readiness claims as governed packet context.

cases.task: When should KRN rename annoying normalized final new class file command names without drifting into vanity naming churn?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A notes-only path can recall naming complaints, but it cannot force source-backed evidence and reject vanity readiness claims before a rename.
